failed: This conference is unavailable. Try again shortly.
endConfirm: End this conference for all participants?
waiting: The conference has not started yet.
joinDescription: Enter the room to listen to the broadcast. A viewer's microphone and camera stay off.
anotherRoom: You already have an ongoing conference. Leave it before joining another room.
recording: This conference is being recorded. The host will decide whether to publish the replay afterwards.

recordingConsent.notice: This conference is being recorded. On stage, your image, your voice and your screen share will be part of the recording.
recordingConsent.where: After the conference, the host decides whether to publish the replay, never beyond the conference audience; it is kept for {{days}} days at most.
recordingConsent.withdraw: You can leave the stage at any time: what follows is no longer recorded, but what has already been recorded stays in the replay, which the host decides on.
recordingConsent.accept: I agree that my image and voice are recorded on the stage of this conference
recordingConsent.given: You have accepted the recording of this conference.
recordingConsent.proposedSpeaker: The host invites you to speak. Accept the recording to go on stage as soon as the conference starts.
recordingConsent.proposedSpeakerLive: The host invites you to speak. Accept the recording to go on stage.
recordingConsent.promotedLater: Your consent is saved. The stage is full for now: the host can bring you on stage as soon as a place opens up.
recordingConsent.hostNotice: This conference is being recorded: a person only goes on stage after accepting the recording.

create.name: Title
